scope: Final-verdict read-only verification; locally authored summary of actual returned checks, not a new provider run or an unchanged upstream test suite.
path_convention: cards/, groups/, invoke_by_tool.json and ../rr or ../html-report paths are relative to token-cards; docs/, recipes/, tools/, adoption/ and evidence/ paths are relative to the main repository. Record names after # identify retained entries, not personal identifiers.
version_checks: Native --version for rtk, toon, headroom and mcporter; installed package.json for gpt-tokenizer and context-mode.
release_method: Fresh official GitHub releases/latest API responses (all HTTP 200), followed by opened official release pages and release/current upstream documentation; search-index snippets were not used as freshness authority.

retained_attachment_check.selection: All records whose component_ids include one of the six verdict tools, unique attachment paths.

historical_comparison_recount.method: Opened the private ledger's retained baseline/candidate paths, checked bytes and SHA256, then re-encoded fatal UTF-8 with installed gpt-tokenizer 3.4.0 cjs/encoding/o200k_base.js; private paths and ledger IDs omitted.
historical_comparison_recount.limit: A matching count and hash does not independently establish semantic acceptance; eligibility comes from each retained boundary and check.

limits: CLI command-text matches can include mentions rather than successful useful execution; MCP matches identify servers.
The 22-child lane-block population is a subset, not an additional population.
Eligible-task opportunity counts and causal provider savings are absent.
The cards retain the preregistered arm-B run as pending.

host_wiring_readback.method: Parsed selected current user/project TOML fields and the portable Codex template; emitted only booleans, command basenames and the named offline guards.
host_wiring_readback.limit: Read-back establishes selected configuration state, not hook execution, concurrent native-session isolation or blanket offline behavior.

toon_bom_check.method: Pass JSON.stringify of the root string U+FEFF followed by true to toon --encode; pass stdout to toon --decode --strict; JSON.parse the decoded stdout and compare types and values.

retrieval_limits.qmd: Query/get returned an indexed historical foundation document; the requested handbook was inspected at its original known repository path.
retrieval_limits.serena: Initialization was attempted but did not return before the call was terminated; no symbol-service success is claimed.
